title: Enforce explicit Student World donor drift semantics
mission: Resolve the verified mismatch between the Student World bridge candidate's exact donor-blob metadata and its runtime iframe dependency on a mutable live Pages path. Make the semantics explicit and mechanically safe: either bind candidate behavior to the recorded donor identity or add deterministic drift detection/labeling so exact-donor fidelity cannot be silently claimed after the live donor changes. Keep the work isolated/candidate-only and do not promote any authority pointer.
definition_of_done: The candidate's donor semantics are explicit in durable source/receipt: immutable donor identity or mutable-current donor with deterministic drift detection.

If exact-donor fidelity remains claimed, runtime or pre-render verification mechanically checks the expected donor identity a2f7a16beaf2d6c44556c87434bccfc4cb168b50 before treating the donor as exact.
If the live mutable donor is intentionally retained, source/metadata cannot silently represent future drift as the originally pinned donor.
A bounded regression check demonstrates that an intentional donor-identity mismatch is detected rather than silently accepted.
The existing Student World donor and Jose routes remain preserve-first; no generic redesign is introduced.
No Current, Catalog, Human Accepted or Served pointer is changed.
